title: Final Thoughts
use_cases: Use when developing a character's internal and verbal voice
Implement when structuring chapters to maintain narrative momentum
Use when applying rhythmic literary devices to prose
Configure when setting up reader engagement strategies for new drafts
content:
Character development begins with voice. By understanding what someone says to themselves and how they choose to verbalize their internal dialogue, you can create a realistic and dependable character.
